# AVONET

Third-party data, vendored unmodified. **Not covered by BirdView's Apache 2.0
license**: it is licensed by its owners under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0
International license, whose full text is in [LICENSE](LICENSE).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **File** | `AVONET Supplementary dataset 1.xlsx` |
| **Origin** | <https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.16586228> |
| **Version** | v7 |
| **Owner** | Tobias et al. |
| **License** | CC BY 4.0 |
| **Modifications** | None. The file is exactly as published, and its hash is checked on every run of the spec checks. |
| **Used for** | Morphology: bill (culmen), wing chord, secondary length, tail and mass. |

**Cite as:**

> Tobias, J. A. et al. 2022. AVONET: morphological, ecological and geographical data for
> all birds. *Ecology Letters* 25: 581–597.

Retrieval details and the SHA-256 this file is checked against are recorded once, in
[spec/sources/avonet/PROVENANCE.md](../../spec/sources/avonet/PROVENANCE.md), and verified
by `spec/check/pins.py`.
